figurative_meaning_en: Exorbitant price or cost as high as gold
similar_in_english: Cost an arm and a leg
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজকাল বাজারে সবকিছুর দাম কাঞ্চনমূল্য হয়ে গেছে।
এই নতুন গাড়িটি কিনতে কাঞ্চনমূল্য খরচ হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Nowadays, everything in the market costs a king's ransom.
Buying this new car will cost an arm and a leg.
note: The idiom draws from the high value of gold to express inflated prices in everyday Bengali commerce.
